_doc: Field list for cc_evidence/baseline.json (schema_version 2), written only by `make_evidence.py freeze`. zhtools/cc_check.py validates schema_version, status, every SHA-256 named here (in-repo files and out-of-repo bulk files) and the indivisible cache key before it can return anything other than UNVERIFIED.

fields.status: "frozen" | "draft"; only frozen evidence may ever produce a verified result; draft lists why in `problems`
fields.srcdir: absolute path of the Make VPATH srcdir
fields.builddir: absolute path of the Make builddir (outside every source tree)
fields.cc: absolute path of the C compiler (/usr/bin/gcc), realpath, no wrapper
fields.cxx: absolute path of the C++ compiler (/usr/bin/g++)
fields.configure_args: list of strings, the complete frozen configure arguments (including CC=/CXX=)
fields.env: the complete `env -i` environment the build and every replay run with
fields.logs: object capture-target name -> sha256 of its `make -j1 -w` log (world_bin, checkprep, check_prereqs, check_prereqs_ecpg, check_prereqs_libpq, check_prereqs_pg_bsd_indent)
fields.n_variants: int, records in commands.jsonl == records in tokens.jsonl
fields.n_objects: int, active .o files found under builddir (excluding tmp_install)
fields.coverage_closed: bool, true only when every .o has an argv and a .Po (own or Make-declared shared), every argv has its .o, every .Po its .o
fields.bulk_files: object name -> {path, sha256, size} of out-of-repo evidence (po_headers.jsonl, headers_base = headers.jsonl of the base replay); the files must exist with these hashes
fields.token_cache_sha256: sha256 over the sorted (variant_key, token_sha256) pairs of the base replay
fields.cache_key_sha256: sha256 of cache_key_material; changing any constituent changes this and invalidates every cached verdict
fields.cache_key_material: object with exactly zhtools.ccreplay.CACHE_KEY_FIELDS: base_commit, configure_args, env, cc_version, cxx_version, make_version, logs, closure_sha256, commands_sha256, flagsets_sha256, po_headers_sha256, tokens_sha256, token_cache_sha256
fields.check_world_exit_code: exit code of the frozen `make -j8 -k -Orecurse -w check-world` run
fields.check_world_log_sha256: sha256 of that log (kept out of the repo)
fields.check_world_failures: sorted list of {dir, kind, test, status, detail}: the baseline failure set; final acceptance must reproduce exactly this set (environment-caused members are explained in evidence/environment.md)
fields.configure_exit_code: exit code of the frozen configure run (must be 0)
fields.coverage: object: tracked_c_h_cpp, covered_tracked, uncovered_tracked, covered_src_paths_total, covered_build_paths_total, variants, variants_src_source, variants_generated_source
fields.po_superset: object: checked (variants compared), own_po_violations (must be empty; side depfile headers missing from the variant's own .Po), inherited_checked, inherited_not_superset (list of {variant_key, po_inherited_from, not_in_po}: _shlib.o/_srv.o variants whose compiler-written header set exceeds the inherited base .Po; recorded, not a freeze problem)
fields.problems: list of strings; empty iff status == frozen

companion_files.closure.json: the .o/.Po/argv three-way closure with every alias, inherited .Po, symlink, foreign object (dtrace -G) and unverified finding listed
companion_files.commands.jsonl: one record per variant: variant_key (builddir-relative object path), cwd (builddir-relative), source, generated, lang, flagset id, log name and line, object, po_file, po_inherited_from
companion_files.flagsets.json: deduplicated argv templates with {SRC}/{OBJ}/{DEP} placeholders; a variant's argv = expand(flagset, record)
companion_files.tokens.jsonl: one record per variant from the base replay: canonical_argv_sha256, token_sha256, n_chunks, n_bytes_pp, source_kind, n_headers, headers_sha256, status (hashes only, byte-identical across replays)
companion_files.replay_base.json: summary of the base replay (n_ok, n_failed, token_cache_sha256, bulk headers path/sha256/size, compiler versions)
companion_files.platform_exceptions_candidates.json: tracked .c/.h/.cpp files not covered by any passing variant, with the first preprocessor conditional as the only hint; status is always "candidate" -- nobody is excepted until a reviewer fills path/platform_guard/reason/reviewed_by/review_commit with status "approved" in platform_exceptions.json
